tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Brand Coral. The mark, the primary button fill (via `primary`) and brand moments. Never body text, never an error.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Brand Charcoal. Logo ink, `on-primary` labels, the dark app icon tile.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Brand Cream. Logo ground and the light theme `surface`.

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Window chrome: top bar, nav tabs, the gutter between sidebar and viewport.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels: the settings sidebar, Copilot panel, dialogs.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, cards and the selected segment inside a panel.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for rows, menu items, ghost buttons and tabs.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: Input, select and number-field fill.

tokens.name: viewport
tokens.usage: 3D viewport and G-code preview background.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines: section dividers, panel edges. Not for control borders.

tokens.name: line-control
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects, checkboxes and secondary buttons; 3:1 on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `field`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface, `field`, `viewport` and `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: units (mm, %), hints, inactive tabs, metadata; 4.5:1 on `bg`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-hover`, `field`.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only (exempt from contrast minimums). Never for readable content.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Fill of the one primary action per area (Slice plate, Export G-code). Label is always `on-primary`.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Primary fill on hover.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Primary fill while pressed.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on `primary` fills (7:1 on Coral). Never white on Coral.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Selection marks: active tab underline, switch on, checkbox fill, modified-setting dot, selected-object outline; 3:1 on every surface and `viewport`.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Coral as text or icon (active tab label, links, Copilot name) on `surface`, `surface-raised`, `bg`, `accent-soft`.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground for selected rows, the checked menu item and active nav tab.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Check glyphs and labels on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, 2px solid with 2px offset; 3:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (sliced OK, printer online) on the surfaces and `success-soft`. Teal, off the red-green axis.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for success notices and badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons (overhangs, preflight findings) on the surfaces and `warning-soft`.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for warning notices and badges.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors and destructive actions, on the surfaces and `danger-soft`. Vermilion, kept clear of brand Coral; always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for error notices and badges.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information and tips, on the surfaces and `info-soft`.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground for info notices and badges.

tokens.name: plate
tokens.usage: The build plate surface in the 3D viewport, on `viewport`.

tokens.name: plate-grid
tokens.usage: Grid lines and the plate edge on `plate`. Decorative.

tokens.name: axis-x
tokens.usage: X axis gizmo and the X field marker. Also the axis letter in X/Y/Z fields, on `field`. Data color, not a status.

tokens.name: axis-y
tokens.usage: Y axis gizmo and the Y field marker. Also the axis letter in X/Y/Z fields, on `field`. Data color, not a status.

tokens.name: axis-z
tokens.usage: Z axis gizmo and the Z field marker. Also the axis letter in X/Y/Z fields, on `field`. Data color, not a status.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modal dialogs.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Nunito at heavy weights echoes the rounded Porca wordmark. Brand moments only.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Home screen and empty-plate hero only.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel hero numbers: slice summary, print time, filament total.

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Figtree with tabular numerals for every number in a field. 13px is the base: the sidebar is dense.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Setting labels, menu items, field values. The default.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, selected preset names, emphasis inside body.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Settings tabs, segmented controls, small buttons, badges.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Setting group headers inside a tab and menu section labels. Always uppercase (text-transform).

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: G-code, Copilot step log, file paths.

styles.name: mono-sm
styles.usage: Nozzle and tool tags, coordinates in the viewport HUD.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inset of a segment inside a segmented control; icon-to-badge nudge.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Gap between an icon and its label in small controls; between stacked menu items.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; gap between paired fields (T1 / T2).

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Field inner padding; gap between controls in a row.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Panel section inner padding (horizontal); gap between setting rows groups.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between panel sections.

tokens.name: space-24
tokens.usage: Dialog padding; space above a setting group header.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Empty states and the home screen.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Checkboxes, tool number chips.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Segments inside a segmented control, menu items, badges (nested inside radius-md).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, segmented control track, filament swatches.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, cards, preset blocks inside a panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the app-icon tile.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switch track and thumb, status dots, the Copilot send button.

size.note: Fixed control heights keep every row in the sidebar on one rhythm.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Segmented control segments, icon buttons in section headers, badges.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of inputs, selects and buttons in the sidebar.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Top-bar actions (Slice plate, Export) and dialog buttons.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: A setting row (label + control) in the Process tabs.

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Icons inside small controls and badges.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Default icon size: section headers, buttons, menus.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Viewport toolbar and nav tabs.

tokens.name: topbar-height
tokens.usage: The top navigation bar.

tokens.name: sidebar-width
tokens.usage: Default width of the settings sidebar (resizable, min 320px).

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Selected segment, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Menus, dropdowns, tooltips.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Modal dialogs.
